title: Reproduce baseline eval report
description: Run existing evaluate_classifier.py on untouched test manifest with models/egg_grader.pth, save reports/damage_baseline_report.json. Verify matches known baseline: acc 0.8667, bal 0.7979, damaged recall 0.9158, confusion [[87,8],[8,17]], 120 samples, device mps. Scripts only, no code changes.
validation: ./.venv/bin/python src/evaluate_classifier.py --labels data/damage/manifests/test.csv --image-root . --checkpoint models/egg_grader.pth --output reports/damage_baseline_report.json && ./.venv/bin/python -c "import json; r=json.load(open('reports/damage_baseline_report.json')); assert r['samples']==120 and r['confusion_matrix']==[[87,8],[8,17]], r"
